scope: Actual isolated macOS application; AppleScript tab operations and screen reads, Runtime input under an owned AI control lease
checks: 实际 QA 应用启动并显示终端标签
通过 AppleScript 创建独立测试标签
取得仅属于本次 QA 的 AI 控制租约
按当前 generation、控制 epoch 与前台进程校验发送终端命令
从实际 App 屏幕读到命令执行结果，排除仅命令回显
通过 Runtime 正常释放本次控制租约
关闭本次创建的测试标签并确认已从实际 App 状态移除
screenshotPublication: Local only; excluded from Git because terminal prompts can identify the local user and host.
